plainTranslation: Raw energy pours into your identity. Driven, bold, maybe combative. Great for starting things and asserting yourself, bad for picking fights. Channel the heat into action, not arguments.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
